## Which file do I download?

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| **Mac** (Apple silicon *and* Intel) | `JarvisSupportHost-<version>-mac-universal.dmg` |
| **Windows** (most PCs) | `JarvisSupportHost-windows-x64.exe` (ARM PCs: `-arm64.exe`) |
| **Linux**, Debian/Ubuntu/Kali | `jarvis-support-host_<version>_amd64.deb` (or `arm64`) |
| **Linux**, anything else | `jarvis-host-<version>-linux-amd64.tar.gz` (or `arm64`) |

Open it and type the address of Jarvis when asked. The app is **not code-signed yet**, so Mac and Windows
will warn the first time: see "First open" in the README. `SHA256SUMS` lets you check the downloads.
Cameras need ffmpeg installed on that computer.
